title: Share a Gem with others

body.text: After creating a Gem, you can
share a link so others can use it right away
— the recipient doesn't have to create the Gem themselves; they just click the link and start chatting with it.

example: "Share the 'Teacher's Assistant' Gem link with the school's teachers so everyone can use it together."

title: Use Google's Gems

body.text: ready-made, prebuilt Gems like Learning Coach, Brainstormer, and Career Guide
you can use right away without building your own — perfect for beginners who aren't sure how to create a Gem yet.

example: "[Open the 'Brainstormer' Gem] Help me brainstorm marketing campaign ideas for a new green-tea product."

question: How do you share a Gem for others to use?

options.text: Share the Gem link for the recipient to click and use
Others must recreate the same Gem themselves

question: Who are Google's prebuilt Gems good for?

options.text: Beginners who want to use a Gem without building one

question: What is the 'Brainstormer' prebuilt Gem used for?

options.text: Helping brainstorm and generate new ideas

question: To use a ready-made assistant Google provides, where do you look?
What's the benefit of sharing a Gem with a team?

options.text: Everyone can use an assistant configured the same way
